key = \"meridian-credits-agreement\"
existing = subprocess.check_output([\"bd\", \"recall\", key], text=True).rstrip()
addition = \"\"\"

The historical memory meridian-credits-agreement-release-1.0 was left unchanged.
\"\"\"
record = existing + addition
subprocess.run([\"bd\", \"remember\", record, \"--key\", key], check=True)
readback = subprocess.check_output([\"bd\", \"recall\", key], text=True)
assert readback.strip() == record.strip(), \"Memory readback mismatch\"

'"

const script = `import subprocess
key = "meridian-credits-agreement"
existing = subprocess.check_output(["bd", "recall", key], text=True).rstrip()
addition = """

Historical statement support verified for trial-7ax ("Generate release 1 statement receipts"), 2026-09-07. Sources: trial-7ax interface requirements and the original Finance approval in trial-owo, both read directly; historical policy also read from meridian-credits-agreement-release-1.0. Explicit release "1.0" is supported for statement with exactly release, lines, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; each response line contains exactly line_id, credit_cents, amount_due_cents in input order. Empty input returns release "1.0", lines [], and zero totals. The 19999-cent single-line receipt yields credit 1999 and due 18000. This consumes the original release 1.0 agreement, including the 2400-cent account-wide cap across subscriptions and earliest service_on then increasing line_id allocation priority; it is not a revision of the calculation agreement. Default statement remains release "2.0", and existing quote/total versions remain supported.

Verified finding for trial-7ax: the existing shared allocator and statement handler already implement the required historical receipts, so no runtime change was needed. Added tests/test_statement_release_1.py now verifies multi-line release 1.0 allocations, including date priority over charge and ID, Unicode ID ties, account caps across subscriptions, independent accounts with the same subscription ID, partial/exhausted caps, input-order preservation under permutations, cap reset, per-line floor rounding, zero/empty and integer boundaries, both date endpoints, exact response shape, and agreement with total. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests passed all 23 methods; all five public suites passed (release_1_quote, release_1_total, release_1_statement, release_2_quote_total, release_2_statement; seven cases overall). git diff --check passed. The historical memory meridian-credits-agreement-release-1.0 was left unchanged.
"""
record = existing + addition
subprocess.run(["bd", "remember", record, "--key", key], check=True)
readback = subprocess.check_output(["bd", "recall", key], text=True)
assert readback.strip() == record.strip(), "Memory readback mismatch"
print(readback)
`;
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -c '"+script.replace(/'/g,"'\\''")+"'",max_output_tokens:6000}));
